data.name: Imama
data.gender_notes: Imama is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Imama refers to the mother of the believers, a term used to describe the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and other revered women in Islamic history. The name Imama carries the meaning “Mother of the believers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imama usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the believers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in spiritual significance for Muslim families, symbolizing devotion and love for the Prophet and his companions.
data.etymology: Imama belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the believers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imama total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: إمامة
in_arabic.meaning: القيادة والرئاسة في الدين أو الدولة
in_arabic.long_meaning: إمامة هي اسم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويشير إلى القيادة والرئاسة في الدين أو الدولة. يأتي من الجذر اللغوي 'أم' الذي يعني 'الأم' أو 'الأصل'، ومنه اشتقت معاني القيادة والإمامة. في السياق الإسلامي، يُستخدم المصطلح للإشارة إلى منصب قيادي أو ديني رفيع، مثل إمامة المسجد أو الإمامة في الصلاة.

in_urdu.name: امامہ
in_urdu.meaning: قیادت، رئاست، دین یا ریاست میں سربراہی
in_urdu.long_meaning: امامہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے۔ یہ قیادت، رئاست، اور دین یا ریاست میں سربراہی کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ 'أم' کے لغوی جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں 'ام' یا 'اصل'، اور اس سے قيادت اور امامہ کے معانی اخذ کیے گئے ہیں۔ اسلامی 맥ام میں، اس 용語 کو اعلیٰ دینی یا قيادی عہدوں کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، جیسے کہ مسجد کی امامت یا نماز میں امامت.

in_hindi.name: इमामाह
in_hindi.meaning: नेतृत्व, अध्यक्षता, धर्म या राज्य में प्रमुखता
in_hindi.long_meaning: इमामाह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। यह नेतृत्व, अध्यक्षता, और धर्म या राज्य में प्रमुखता के अर्थ में है। यह 'أم' के लिंगویिस्टिक मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'माँ' या 'मूल', और इससे नेतृत्व और इमामाह के अर्थ निकाले गए हैं। इस्लामी संदर्भ में, इस शब्द का उपयोग उच्च धार्मिक या नेतृत्व पदों के लिए किया जाता है, जैसे कि मस्जिद की इमामत या نماز में इमामत।

in_pashto.name: امامہ
in_pashto.meaning: مشريقيت، قيادت، دين یا حكومت كې لوړه پوزيشن
in_pashto.long_meaning: امامہ یوه ښځینه نوم دی چی اصلي عربي ريښه لري. دا مشريقيت، قيادت، او دين یا حكومت كې لوړه پوزيشن په معنا ده. دا د 'أم' د لغوي جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی معنی یې ده 'مور' یا 'اصل'، او پكې د قيادت او امامہ معانی شامل دي. په اسلامي سياق كې، دا اصطلاح د لوړو دينی يا قيادي مناصب لپاره كارول كيږي، لکه د مسجد امامت یا په نماز كې امامت.

in_english.name: Imama
in_english.meaning: Leadership, presidency, high position in religion or state
in_english.long_meaning: Imama is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It signifies leadership, presidency, and high position in religious or state matters. Etymologically derived from the root 'أم' (ʾum), meaning 'mother' or 'origin', it encompasses concepts of guidance and authority. In Islamic context, the term is used for high religious or leadership roles, such as leading prayers or heading a community. The name reflects qualities of leadership, piety, and responsibility, making it a meaningful choice for a child.

data.cultural_impact: The way the term "Imama" has been used in Islamic history to refer to the mothers of the believers, namely Aisha, Hafsa, Um Salama, Um Ra’dah, and Zainab bint Jahsh, among others, reflects the profound respect and honor given to these women in Islamic tradition. These women were close companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and played significant roles in transmitting Hadith (sayings and actions of the Prophet) and Sunnah (the Prophet's practices) to the next generation. They served as models of piety, courage, wisdom, and resilience for Muslim women to emulate.
data.spiritual_significance: The mothers of the believers are held in high esteem in the Islamic tradition not only for their historical significance but also for their deep spiritual connections to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the divine message of Islam. Their unwavering faith, devotion, and perseverance despite the challenges they faced serve as testimonies to the transformative power of faith. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) himself is reported to have said, "The best of you is your mother" (Sunan At-Tirmidhi 3924), emphasizing the importance of showing love and respect to one's mother – an emotional bond that can also foster a deeper spiritual connection. In this sense, the term "Imama" carries with it an enduring message of respect, honor, and reverence for the mothers of believers and for all mothers, reinforcing the strong bond between spirituality and family in Islamic tradition.
